mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 0.3% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%, or rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 AND INDPRO > 100, or rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0%), central bank policy reduces liquidity and increases equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0 AND CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0%, or rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1200) indicate weak residential demand, signaling economic slowdown and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day returns < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing starts (HOUST < 1200) combined with low residential fixed investment (RSAFS < 480000) indicate a contracting housing market, reducing consumer confidence and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances where HOUST < 1200 AND RSAFS < 480000, or rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with strong job growth (PAYEMS > 145000) indicates robust economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 AND PAYEMS > 145000, or rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
